title: Amazon Route 53 Hosted Zone
description: A JSON Schema representation of an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone, which is a container for records that define how to route traffic for a domain and its subdomains.

Id.description: The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigned to the hosted zone when it was created.

Name.description: The name of the domain. For public hosted zones, this is the name that you registered with your DNS registrar.

CallerReference.description: The value that you specified for CallerReference when you created the hosted zone.

Config.description: A complex type that includes the Comment and PrivateZone elements.

Comment.description: Any comments that you want to include about the hosted zone.

PrivateZone.description: A value that indicates whether this is a private hosted zone.

ResourceRecordSetCount.description: The number of resource record sets in the hosted zone.

LinkedService.description: If the hosted zone was created by another service, the service that created the hosted zone.

ServicePrincipal.description: The service that created the hosted zone.

Description.description: A description provided by the other service.

DelegationSet.description: The name servers that are associated with the hosted zone.

Id.description: The ID of the reusable delegation set.

CallerReference.description: The value that you specified for CallerReference when you created the reusable delegation set.

NameServers.description: A list of the authoritative name servers for the hosted zone.

VPCs.description: A list of VPCs associated with a private hosted zone.
